sessionStats.ruleText: [session pattern] in recent Honu sessions (≥ 100 kills counted): assists per kill ≤ 0.1, headshot share ≥ 50% (headshot XP per kill; Census lifetime HSR when no XP detail) and K/D ≥ 7 (session deaths; Census lifetime KD when none). A very one-sided record; a lead for manual review, not proof.

metrics.label: Assists / kill
metrics.tip: Kill assists per kill in recent sessions (cheaters rarely share kills)

metrics.label: Assist dmg share
metrics.tip: Average damage share of an assist (from assist XP ÷ kill XP)

metrics.label: Session KPM
metrics.tip: Kills per minute over all counted sessions

metrics.label: Best-session KPM
metrics.tip: Highest KPM of one session (≥ 10 min, ≥ 20 kills)

metrics.label: KPM spread (CV)
metrics.tip: Std-dev ÷ mean of per-session KPM (how uneven sessions are)

metrics.label: Session K/D
metrics.tip: Kills ÷ deaths in counted sessions (deaths = kill events on the player)

metrics.label: Best-session K/D
metrics.tip: Highest K/D of one session (same minimum as best KPM; deaths floored at 1)

metrics.label: Kill-streak / kill
metrics.tip: Kill Streak XP events per kill (share of kills made while on a streak)

metrics.label: Revenge ÷ domination
metrics.tip: Revenge kills per domination kill (low = dominates, rarely needs revenge)

metrics.label: Savior / kill
metrics.tip: Savior kills (saving a teammate) per kill

metrics.label: Priority / kill
metrics.tip: Priority + high-priority kills per kill (bounty / streak targets)

metrics.label: Streak stops / kill
metrics.tip: Stop Kill Streak events per kill
